dedupe_keys.name: replication package for a retrospective study of state aid control in the german broadband market

description: Researchers at KU Leuven, DIW Berlin and Université Libre de Bruxelles publish the replication package for an evaluation of German broadband subsidies. The March 2025 Zenodo deposit provides data, programs and instructions in a ZIP archive, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The primary article identifies municipalities in Bavaria and Lower Saxony and examines broadband coverage, provider entry and service prices around rural deployment subsidies. An earlier working paper describes a 2005–2015 municipal panel; exact coverage of the final deposited package remains unverified. These materials can inform policy-response and investment assumptions in broadband deployment simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Archive-internal file formats, software versions and restrictions on underlying sources require its instructions. The published policy-effect estimates and identification assumptions were not independently assessed, and the package was not executed. A historical subsidy evaluation should not be treated as a calibrated forecast for current markets.
